responsibility: Implements reachability analysis over the region_model’s store graph. Starting from globals, escaped clusters, symbolic roots, parameters, or explicit seeds, it recursively discovers reachable and mutable base regions and svalues through pointer and compound-value links, and can mark mutable reachable clusters as escaped while notifying the analysis context about escaped function regions, supporting unknown-call effects and leak analysis.
same_name_distinction: Implements the reachable_regions traversal declared in region-model-reachability.h, including cluster initialization, recursive propagation through pointers and compound values, mutability tracking, escape marking, and debug dumping.
